title: 第262章 什么叫别家的兵最香？演武的正式开场—五公里武装越野！
slug: 三角洲招募威龙创电竞gti
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

没错，假设威龙如果真的是现实世界的人，凭借着他所拥有的特战素质，

就算是全军大演武，国际战术展示赛上都是能拔得头筹的顶尖特战兵王！

毕竟就算是在十几年后的时间线，在三角洲的2038年往后的时间线，

他也是作为唯一一个能驾驭身上这套动能辅助装置的人而游走战场的，

说是世界唯一可能不太现实，

但百万中无一，连哈夫克这种跨国际科技大亨都没办法找出第二个能驾驭这套装置的特殊人才，

威龙的含金量自是可想而知，绝对是每一个战区里不可替代的特战标杆！

而正是这种部队里的顶尖人才，他在兵役阶段是根本不轮不到正常退役，

属于是重点保留，重点培养，长期留队的对象！

即便是不走提干的军官路线，也会被要求一直干到二级，一级军士长的位置直到接近退休才肯放人！

不然的话，但凡你只透露了一丝想走的意思，

别说是连队了，团里，旅部的高层都会亲自出面进行层层挽留，目的就是能让你留下来。

而现在，虽然说徐强军是不知道上面说的那些有关威龙的履历以及特殊性，

但就仅凭他第一眼看过去的感觉，

作为宣传处的处长，

作为见识过了这么多特战尖子，还给他们亲自指导拍摄，剪辑视频的宣传处的人，

他是一眼就能看出来威龙身上有着一种普通兵所没有的气质，是独属于兵王级的特质！

所以他现在就很好奇了....到底是哪个部队会舍得这么早就把一个兵王级悍将放去退伍啊？

眼看着对方这个年纪撑死了也没到三十岁，这么早就放人退伍这部队里那些家伙的一贯作风啊！

还是说对方其实是因身体有恙，以及其他各种不同原因的非正常退伍兵？

但这看着也不像啊，如果真是这种意外情况的话，也不可能有现在这个精神头吧？

“嘶，突然有点想要这个兵了怎么办？”

虽然早就已经脱离战斗岗，走上了办公室文职的道路，但是徐强军在看到那种有潜力的兵时，

他也仍然是很渴望收入麾下，并加以培养的！

尤其是这个兵大概率还是其他战区手底下却没得到培养，或者是退伍了的这种情况，

他表示他是真原因接过来的！

什么？你说人都退伍了，怎么还能“返聘”回来了吗？

诶～小同志，退伍了难道就不能二次入伍了？

如果对面的这个兵当真拥有部队顶尖的特战素质，如果不是他看走眼的话，

他就是直接用掉一个“特招入伍”的名额直接将其召回，甚至直接授衔也是不为过的！

当前前提还是得像上面说的一样，是真有顶尖的特战素养以及他本人有意愿重归部队！

毕竟部队又不是什么流氓组织，哪还能你不愿意还强行给你绑回去？

徐强军如此想着，然后下意识就点了点头，对着威龙露出了一副和善的笑容，

让对方曾一度感受到了背后有些发凉，好似回忆起了自己曾经的往事！

没错，他当初在被听说自己要被调配到其他军种的时候，那里也有一个老班长对他露出过同款表情。

让他至今记忆犹新。

“咳咳，那什么....既然都来了，那咱们这就准备开始吧，我这就联系飞龙的人过来。”

似乎是注意到自己刚才的表现有些失态，徐强军有些尴尬的咳嗽了一声，

也不好再接着去打量剩下几个人搞得他好像要吃了人家一样。

他直接重整面部表情，恢复了最开始的状态，然后对着林修发出了邀请。

“好的领导，那就麻烦你带我们前往作训场了。”

徐强军闻言点了点头，然后一边示意身边的助手去通知飞龙特战队派出来拍摄的兵，

一边就亲自带着林修一行人前往了基地内目前空置的，也是最大的一处训练场地——R3号含越野作训场。

R3号含越野作训场，

顾名思义，这是一个放置了无论是全军演武还是国际战术展示赛都必须要有的开胃前菜——

五公里武装越野场地的专属作训场。

按照一般全军演武的惯例，

无论接下来要具体比些什么，首先都得是要完成一场自带三十公斤负重的五公里武装越野热热身，

然后才正式展开比试的。

That's right, assuming that Weilong is really a person in the real world, with his special combat qualities,

Even if the entire army performs martial arts, there are top special operations soldiers who can come out on top in international tactical exhibition competitions!

After all, even in the timeline more than ten years later, in the timeline after 2038 in Delta,

He is also the only one who can control the kinetic energy auxiliary device on his body and walks on the battlefield.

It may not be realistic to say that it is the only one in the world.

But there is not one in a million, and even an international technology tycoon like Huffke can’t find a second special talent who can control this device.

The gold content of the Veyron can be imagined, and it is definitely an irreplaceable benchmark for special operations in every war zone!

And it is for this kind of top talent in the army that he will not be eligible for normal retirement during the military service stage.

They are the ones who should be retained, trained and kept in the team for a long time!

Even if you don't take the officer route, you will be required to work until the second level. The position of first-level sergeant major will not be released until you are close to retirement!

Otherwise, if you only reveal a hint of wanting to leave,

Not to mention the company, the senior leaders of the regiment and brigade will personally come forward to persuade you to stay, with the goal of making you stay.

And now, although Xu Qiangjun does not know the experience and special characteristics of Weilong mentioned above,

But just based on his first look at it,

As the director of the Publicity Department,

As a member of the publicity department who has seen so many top special operations personnel and personally guided them in shooting and editing videos,

He could tell at a glance that Weilong had a temperament that ordinary soldiers did not have. It was a trait unique to the King of Soldiers!

So he was very curious now... Which army would be willing to retire a warrior-level warrior so early?

Seeing that the opponent was dying at this age and he was not even thirty years old, he was released from the army so early. This is the consistent style of those guys in the army!

Or is it that the other party is actually an abnormal veteran due to physical illness or various other reasons?

But it doesn't look like it. If it were such an unexpected situation, it would be impossible for him to be as energetic as he is now, right?

"Hey, what should I do if I suddenly want this soldier?"

Although Xu Qiangjun had already left the combat post and embarked on the path of office civilian work, when he saw that kind of potential soldier, he

He is still very eager to take him under his wing and train him!

Especially when there is a high probability that this soldier is a subordinate from other theaters but has not been trained, or has retired from the army.

He said he took it for the real reason!

What?You said that people have retired from the army, how can they still be "re-employed"?

Hey, little comrade, after being discharged from the army, can’t I enlist in the army a second time?

If the soldier on the opposite side really has the top special warfare qualities of the army, if he hadn't made a mistake,

It is not an exaggeration for him to directly use up a "special recruitment" quota to directly recall him, or even directly award him with a title!

The current premise still has to be as mentioned above, that he really has top-notch special operations qualities and that he himself is willing to return to the army!

After all, the army is not a rogue organization, so how can they force you to be kidnapped back if you don't want to?

Xu Qiangjun thought this, and then nodded subconsciously, showing a kind smile to Weilong,

The other party once felt a chill in his back, as if he was recalling his past!

That's right, when he heard that he was going to be deployed to other branches of the military, an old squad leader there also showed him the same expression.

It still remains fresh in his memory.

"Ahem, so what... Now that we're all here, let's get ready to start. I'll contact Feilong's people to come over."

Xu Qiangjun coughed awkwardly as if he noticed that his performance just now was a little awkward.

It's not good to continue to look at the remaining people and make him feel like he wants to eat them.

He directly reset his facial expression, returned to the original state, and then extended an invitation to Lin Xiu.

"Okay leader, please take us to the training ground."

Xu Qiangjun nodded when he heard this, and then motioned to his assistants to notify the soldiers sent by the Feilong Special Forces to shoot.

While he was there, he personally took Lin Xiu and his team to the currently vacant and largest training venue in the base - the R3 cross-country training ground.

R3 includes a cross-country training ground.

As the name suggests, this is an appetizer that is a must-have whether it is a military exercise or an international tactical display competition——

An exclusive training ground on a five-kilometer armed cross-country course.

According to the general practice of military exercises,

No matter what the specific competition is next, you must first complete a five-kilometer armed cross-country warm-up with a 30-kilogram weight.

Then the competition officially started.
